text:
𝗦𝗥𝗜 𝗟𝗔𝗡𝗞𝗔 𝗔 𝗖𝗛𝗔𝗦𝗘 𝟯𝟭𝟴! 🔥

Croospulle 116 and Jayawardena 105 added 174 for the first wicket. Sri Lanka A beat India A by 8 wickets with 51 balls left and reach the Rising Stars final.

#RisingStars #Cricket

facebook.caption:
𝗦𝗥𝗜 𝗟𝗔𝗡𝗞𝗔 𝗔 𝗡𝗘 𝟯𝟭𝟴 𝗖𝗛𝗔𝗦𝗘 𝗞𝗜𝗬𝗔! 🔥🏏

👉 India A: 317/8 (Abhishek 78, Shahbaz 54*, Tilak 53)
👉 Croospulle 116 aur Jayawardena 105 — pehle wicket ke liye 174 run
👉 Sri Lanka A 318/2, 41.3 over mein, 8 wicket se jeet
👉 Ab final mein Sunday ko khelenge

Aapke hisaab se India A se kahan chook hui — bowling ya fielding?

#CricketKiBaat #RisingStars #IndiaA
